title: Fra Giovanni di Lucca to Ferdinand III, 30 May 1644 (DECODE R2159, ÖStA HHStA Staatskanzlei Interiora, Chiffrenschlüssel Kt. 20 Fasc. 27 ff. 18-19)

steps.what: Unconstrained homophonic annealing, 16 restarts; converges on a non-Italian optimum.
Tomokiyo's crib 'Al principe di' taken literally needs 17 = i and n.
Eight consistent crib letters fixed, other 16 figures annealed; all six seeds agree on Italian.
Polyphony 17 = i/n, 19 = t/s read off the contexts.
Same procedure on five shufflings scores -3.40 to -3.68 per 5-gram against -2.50.
Viterbi over the alternatives reads all 231 groups; two spots ambiguous.
DECODE R2159 images P1-P2 fetched with the account cookie (first session had only Tomokiyo's transcription).
Cipher checked group by group against f. 18r: the writer's crossed 4 was transcribed as 17 in ten groups (principe x2, mandero, con, una, non x2, vinto); corrected to 14.
With the corrections 17 = i only; Viterbi changes only Bogodanna->Bogodania and no il habi->non l'habi. Clear frame names Koniecpolski as the speaker, dated Brody 30 May 1644.

Polyphony withdrawn after G. Lasry's review: 19 is s (six times, s has no other figure); the three places needing t are encipherment slips (19 in both places of Transiuania on the image). Key table and page corrected.

outcome.method: key recovered based on plaintext from external sources
outcome.method_basis: The key was rebuilt by annealing with eight letters fixed from Tomokiyo's published partial decipherment 'Al principe di trenti...' (cryptiana variable2.htm), found before the attempt; the clear frame of the letter was not seen until the second session.
outcome.notes: Transcription corrected against the DECODE images 22 Sept 2026 (ten 17->14); 17 is not polyphonic; 19 = s, its three t-contexts are the writer's encipherment slips (G. Lasry, 21 Sept 2026: no polyphony here). Odd spellings ogn, Transiuania look like the writer's. Speaker Koniecpolski per the clear frame.

prior.where: Tomokiyo's unsolved page: opening 'Al principe di trenti...' only

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
